purpose: Map the v80 family housing-benefit demand/friction signal into permanent regressions in the SAME Stödassistenten learning system without creating a separate housing app, matcher or truth layer.

mappings.product_miss: The canonical product already knew the young-under-29 housing-benefit route and explicitly indicated that families with children need a different route, but lacked a canonical family housing-benefit truth record and family-specific regression package.
mappings.fix_or_guardrail: Add the family housing-benefit record to the existing canonical support layer, preserve NEEDS_REVIEW until human verification, ask housing-size facts only when the child's residence pattern makes them material, preserve 2026 annual-income versus 2027 monthly-transition versioning, and keep sv/ar/fa semantically aligned. Public runtime wiring remains in the same person shell and must reuse this truth rather than create a second matcher.
mappings.truth_boundary: Usage statistics and natural-language discovery are not truth. Current Försäkringskassan primary guidance is required for material eligibility, child-residence, household, income-period, amount, document, cross-border and application claims. Do not guarantee eligibility or amount. Do not treat the 2027 transition as current 2026 law for an individual application.
